description_en: Provides a comprehensive set of built-in rule libraries for container security policies in ACK clusters, including Compliance, Infra, K8s-general, and PSP, to ensure secure container operations in production environments. You can call the DescribePolicies operation to query the list of policy governance rule libraries
description_zh: ACK集群容器安全策略供了种类丰富的内置规则库，包括Compliance、Infra、K8s-general和PSP，旨在确保容器在生产环境中的安全运行。您可以调用DescribePolicies接口，查询策略治理规则库的列表
name: DescribePolicies
